title: Prime Watersports
specs: The only place in Fort Lauderdale where you can ride intracoastal and ocean.
You must be 18 to rent a jet ski.
Florida requires anyone born after 1987 to obtain a boating license. The cost is $9.99.
gap: No jet ski or boat rental prices published
blurb: Prime Watersports offers jet ski and boat rentals, allowing customers to ride both the intracoastal and the ocean in Fort Lauderdale. Their services include a boat ride as part of the experience. They emphasize the importance of reservations to guarantee a rental. Florida boating license requirements and age restrictions apply.
extraNote: All reservations require a deposit to confirm your jet ski, jet car, or boat rental. · Deposit is non-refundable if the reservation is canceled within 48 hours of the scheduled rental time. · Modifications made within 24 hours of the scheduled rental time are subject to a 25% fee of the total rental cost. · Cancellations or modifications made more than 48 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund or change without penalty, subject to availability.
